name: toolchain is probed, not assumed
note: Read-only: works with no authorisation and no target.

name: interfaces are listed read-only
query: what wifi interfaces do I have
note: On a machine with no wireless tool it names what to install.

name: monitor capability reports the driver's own answer
query: can I capture packets on wlan0
note: Injection is reported as unknown rather than assumed.

name: survey is read-only
note: A scan needs a scan tool; it never injects.

name: capture without authorisation is refused
note: authorized=true and confirm=true are both required, plus a bssid.

name: capture without a bssid is refused
note: An unnamed AP would record every network in range.

name: deauth without a client is refused
note: Broadcast deauth disconnects networks that are not the target.

name: rogue AP needs an essid and its own policy rule
note: The second gate: a rogue AP answers to strangers.
